groups.heading: Requirements
items: 3 years' experience as a UX/UI designer
Proficient in design software
Portfolio of design projects
Excellent communication skills

groups.heading: What you'll do
items: Create UX/UI designs for mobile and web based on client requirements
Present design concepts and deliverables on the agreed timeline
Collaborate with designers, clients, executives, developers and product managers to improve the user experience
Study design briefs and determine requirements

groups.heading: Job requirements
items: 3 years of .NET experience
.NET Core 2.2 or 3.1 is a must
Microservices with good Docker knowledge
AWS or Azure infrastructure knowledge
Familiar with modern CI/CD pipelines

groups.heading: Responsibilities
items: Review and analyse programming systems, including coding, testing and debugging, to deliver client requirements
Deliver development tasks within agreed timelines
Work with the project manager and consultants to understand the business and application requirements of each task
Write technical documentation for all customisations and integrations
